Server-authoritative page-load reconcile confirmed. With the backend at enabled=false, a fresh load rendered experimental-functions-toggle unchecked; with the backend at enabled=true, a fresh load flipped it to checked at ~8000 ms. The reconcile (load_reconcile_experimental_functions, :4784) fires once on params-init-interval and writes BOTH the toggle value and experimental-flags-store from the same response -- observed on the wire as {'experimental-functions-toggle': {'value': true}, 'experimental-flags-store': {'data': {'experimental_functions': true}}}.

Toggling ON POSTed and the response's enabled is what the UI reflects: GET /api/admin/experimental_functions went false -> true and the switch showed checked. METHOD NOTE (durable): a raw JS .click() is INERT on this dbc.Switch -- it left both .checked and the backend untouched across a 10-sample fast poll. The React-controlled idiom (native `checked` property descriptor + dispatched click/change) is what drives it, the same technique the numeric inputs need. Segment 12's 'JS .click() drives the real callback chain' holds for <button>, not for switch checkboxes.

The Live Dataset Switch is unreachable: its gate callback never emits, so the button is permanently disabled and the entire hot-swap surface (C2.7-10, C2.10-02, C2.10-03, workflow W7) cannot be entered from the dashboard. EVIDENCE, all live on canopy 56ce45f. (1) The button ships disabled=True (dashboard_manager.py:1279-1280). (2) Its disabled prop has exactly ONE writer, gate_live_switch_button (:4894-4901), whose handler returns `not (flags_ok and running)` (_gate_live_switch_button_handler, :5732-5741). (3) The callback IS registered -- GET /dashboard/_dash-dependencies lists 182 callbacks including output 'live-dataset-switch-button.disabled' with inputs ['experimental-flags-store', 'training-status-store']. (4) BOTH inputs are provably correct ON THE WIRE: _dash-update-component responses carry {'training-status-store': {'data': {'is_running': true, 'phase': 'candidate'}}} and {'experimental-flags-store': {'data': {'experimental_functions': true}}}, repeatedly. (5) Yet ZERO _dash-update-component responses ever carry live-dataset-switch-button -- across a 120 s watch, a full page reload with a response hook armed from before load, and a forced experimental OFF->ON toggle. The callback is registered, its inputs update, and it never fires. ROOT CAUSE NOT ISOLATED -- that is fix-phase work (same disposition as F-CANOPY-016). WHY THIS HID: the only prior record of this surface is W7-step1 PASS (run 20260810T002233Z:63), the DENY arm -- 'exp toggle OFF + training running -> button disabled'. A gate that never opens satisfies every should-be-disabled assertion, so the deny arm passing is not evidence the gate works; the ALLOW arm had never been driven. Distinct from F-CANOPY-004 (server-callback lag): the same page demonstrably updated other surfaces throughout (network-info-panel moved 0 -> 6 hidden units), and 120 s exceeds the documented lag while both stores were already correct.
